schema_documentation:
Two key-sets (stats json): 6,342 records with the full 7 keys, 18 records with only `title`+`url`.
- `title` — str, 100%, nonempty 100%. Resource label, 4–139 chars, mean 38.0. 5,995/6,360 titles carry NO accent marks at all (my scan) — unaccented Greek.
- `url` — str, 100%. Always `http://photodentro.edu.gr/aggregator/lo/photodentro-lor-8521-<id>`, 64–66 chars.
- `text` — str, 99.72% (6,342). Resource description, 7–2,412 chars, mean 392.3, nonempty 100%.
- `notes` — str, 99.72%, nonempty 99.84%. Heterogeneous: 2,843 bare date `dd/mm/yyyy`, 481 bare duration `h:mm:ss`, 441 short non-prose (383 of them CEFR level codes: Α1-στοιχειώδης γνώση ×173, Α2-βασική γνώση ×127, B1 ×67, B2 ×16), 10 empty, 2,567 real pedagogical prose (≥60 chars). My counts.
- `keywords` — list[str], 99.72%. 33,540 items, mean 5.3/record, 1–46 chars each.
- `classification` — dict, 99.72%: `.learning_object_type` (str, 2–555), `.thematic_area` (list[str], 10,249 items, mean 58.8 chars, `>`-separated hierarchy), `.teaching_approach` (str, 11 enum values, empty 26.1%), `.educational_objective` (str, 20 enum values, empty 27.0%).
- `audience` — dict, 99.72%: `.educational_levels` (list[str], 6 enum values), `.age_range` (str, e.g. "4 - 7"), `.target_audience` (list[str], 3 enum values).
semantic_meaning: 6,360 Greek metadata blurbs describing learning objects in the national school digital repository photodentro.edu.gr — descriptions of resources, not the resources themselves.
